paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Giyori. See the entry R' Yitzchak, son of R' Yaakov bar Giyori.[^1]

notes.text: The target adds Yaakov bar Giyori as the father. בר׳ is read as “son of R'” in this parentage context, preserving its abbreviated title component rather than dropping it or expanding it to Rabbi. All three abbreviated titles remain R'.
